sloka: सुमाली जनयामास यदपत्यं निशाचरः ।केतुमत्यां महाराज तन्निबोधानुपूर्वशः ।। ७.५.३९ ॥
transliteration: sumālī janayāmāsa yadapatyaṁ niśācaraḥ ।ketumatyāṁ mahārāja tannibodhānupūrvaśaḥ ।। 7.5.39 ॥

translations.english: O great king, now learn in due order about the offspring that the demon Sumali begot through Ketumati.
